issues: 柔光扫掠是一块盖在字上方的径向光斑，光晕溢出字形，在黑底上糊成一团白雾（Q4 光溢出圆角/字形）
液态字像贴在平涂 #08070c 上的一张贴纸：没有发光感，背景也没有任何层次
冲白后整个后半场是大面积纯 #fff 死白，“过曝”与“定妆纸面”是同一种白
扁平字标只做透明度 + 0.96→1 缩放，落定缺少收束感；DesignStage 用 transform 放大 4 倍
changes: 高光改为与液态渐变同层、经 background-clip:text 裁进字形的高光带，静置段（t 0–0.34）自左向右扫过字面，只亮在字上
液态字下垫同色渐变的模糊 bloom（blur 9px、0.38，随冲白熄灭）；静置期字标随流光极缓推近 1→1.025，冲白脉冲时再前冲 3%
暗场改为带色相的深色渐变 + 字后冷紫余光 + 暗角 + 0.08 颗粒
白层仍“冲入后保持”：峰值纯白后 t=0.42–0.56 曝光回落成暖白纸面（#fbfbf9→#efefeb + 轻暗角 + 0.035 颗粒）
扁平字标入场加 1.2px→0 对焦模糊与字距 9.5→8 收拢；两层 DesignStage 改 raster="zoom"；冲白窗口 0.34–0.42、过曝脉冲、0.48–0.74 入场、字号 62/58、GRAD_A/B/C 全部保持（md 动效核心与已知坑同步）
issuesEn: The highlight sweep was a radial blob laid over the text; its glow spilled outside the glyphs into a white haze on black (Q4 light spill)
The liquid wordmark looked like a sticker on flat #08070c — no glow, and no depth in the background
After the flash the whole second half was a large field of pure #fff, so the overexposure and the final paper were the same white
The flat logo only faded in with a 0.96→1 scale, with little sense of locking into place; DesignStage magnified 4× via transform
changesEn: The highlight is now a band in the same layer as the liquid gradient, clipped into the glyphs with background-clip:text, sweeping left to right across the letters during the rest phase (t 0–0.34) and lighting only the letters

A blurred bloom of the same gradient sits under the liquid letters (blur 9px, 0.38, extinguished by the flash); the wordmark creeps in 1→1.025 during the rest phase and pushes another 3% on the flash pulse
The dark field is a tinted dark gradient with a cool violet glow behind the word, a vignette and 0.08 grain
The white layer still holds after flashing in: past the pure-white peak, exposure eases back over t=0.42–0.56 into a warm paper (#fbfbf9→#efefeb, light vignette, 0.035 grain)

The flat logo enters with a 1.2px→0 focus blur and tracking tightening 9.5→8; both DesignStages use raster="zoom"; the 0.34–0.42 flash window, overexposure pulse, 0.48–0.74 entrance, 62/58 sizes and GRAD_A/B/C are unchanged (md motion core and pitfalls updated)
